+    * Allow/suppress Line connecting markers.

+   private $isLine = TRUE;

+   /** duplicate suggestion from Github user GajowyJ */
+   public function isLine(bool $new=NULL) : bool
+   {
+       if ( is_null($new) )
+           return $this->isLine;

+       $this->isLine = $new;
